startup_command: /bin/sh -c alembic upgrade head && exec uvicorn app.entrypoints.integration_api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8095

/usr/local/bin/live-delivery-admission /bin/sh -c export DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD="$(cat /run/secrets/n8n_db_password)"; export N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(cat /run/secrets/n8n_encryption_key)"; exec n8n start

docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c wal_level=replica -c archive_mode=on -c archive_command=/usr/local/sbin/codestra-shared-postgres-stage-wal.sh %p %f -c archive_timeout=60s -c max_wal_senders=10 -c max_replication_slots=10 -c wal_compression=on
